p: Northgate is at the top end of Halifax town centre, and you're only a few minutes' walk from the town's crown jewel, the Piece Hall, a stunning Georgian cloth hall with a huge open courtyard now full of independent shops, bars and cafés.

The Borough Market, a grand Victorian covered market, is close by too, and Halifax Minster is worth a look on the way. If you've got kids with you, Eureka! The National Children's Museum by the station is brilliant. Dean Clough, the vast old carpet mill turned arts and business complex, is a short walk away as well. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, 18+ only, so it's a grown-ups' stop. You won't go hungry in Halifax, with great food in and around the Piece Hall.
